· MACD histogram trajectory (-6.1801→-2.2150) + Improvement diagnosed + Weakening bearish signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Mid-band $443.20) + Bandwidth 20.47%, suggesting potential for increased volatility.

· Swing resistance ($444.29) + Potential for further upside upon breakout.

· Current phase diagnosis (Attempting upward reversal after accumulation phase) + 1x target position filled, next move is leverage.
